headword: {家庭裁判所|かていさいばんしょ}

definitions.explanation: A court that handles family matters such as divorce, inheritance, and guardianship disputes, and cases of juvenile delinquency. Commonly shortened to {家裁|かさい}.

examples.japanese: {家庭裁判所|かていさいばんしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{立|た}てる→申し立てる：27400_moushitateru⟧。
examples.english: To file a petition with the family court.

examples.japanese: ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調停|ちょうてい}→調停：14251_choutei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{家庭裁判所|かていさいばんしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Divorce mediation takes place at the family court.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{家庭裁判所|かていさいばんしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}られて→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}められる→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Juvenile cases are first sent to the family court, which decides how they will be dealt with.

notes:
Its two main jobs are ⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (family cases: divorce, inheritance, guardianship), usually handled first through ⟦{調停|ちょうてい}→調停：14251_choutei⟧ (mediation), and ⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (juvenile cases).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家裁|かさい}: family court (short form, common in news)
- {家庭裁判所|かていさいばんしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{立|た}てる→申し立てる：27400_moushitateru⟧: to petition the family court
- {家庭裁判所|かていさいばんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調停|ちょうてい}→調停：14251_choutei⟧: family court mediation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地方裁判所|ちほうさいばんしょ}→地方裁判所：31531_chihousaibansho⟧: district court — ordinary civil and criminal cases
- {簡易裁判所|かんいさいばんしょ}: summary court — minor cases
